body: Post-merge live checks of PRs #223-#226 at f5d6f12, 2026-09-28 (Mac sandbox restored to clean by the owner; Galaxy Note 10+).U+000AU+000AU+002D 10.9 Mac, Japanese app switch: PASS, 3 of 3 (plain build, Japanese - Romaji). After nihongo, Space, Return, Finder and back, Return: the note held the converted word plus a new line (日本語訳, 日本語字幕, 日本語歌詞). Variant: a second word typed after returning landed after the first (日本語学です). The pre-fix build (aa5bf95) under the same steps left only a line break. Evidence: testkit/results/macos/sandbox-2026-09-28-postmerge.U+000AU+002D Mac keyboard laps, not required by the spec (done anyway): Tab and Shift+Tab each walk the sidebar and every Settings control in one run, 18 stops a lap, identical laps. Every stop is scrolled into view, including the wrap to Delete all at the bottom edge and the first control at the top edge. No `Failed to update ui::AXTree` in three runs.U+000AU+002D 10.10 phone: PASS.U+000A  U+002D Tab and Shift+Tab laps: 16 stops each, 3 identical laps per direction, reverse order for Shift+Tab. Settings forms one run; disabled sync controls and the unavailable Spell check are skipped.U+000A  U+002D Every focused control and its whole ring stay on screen, including the wrap-around switch and Delete all.U+000A  U+002D The lime outline appeared at 0 of 90 stops, and edge pixels stay at page colour.U+000A  U+002D Evidence: testkit/results/android/phone-2026-09-28-postmerge.U+000AU+002D New finding, pre-existing (the aa5bf95 build shows it too; TextEdit does not): in the note editor, right after a Japanese conversion is committed, Cmd+A then Delete leaves the reading in kana (にほん, にほんごば) instead of an empty note. Mechanism unverified.U+000AU+002D Observations:U+000A  U+002D Reveal scrolls the least distance, so at the top edge a control's row title can sit just above the visible area.U+000A  U+002D The text-size option's ring overlaps its group outline, as accepted.U+000AU+002D Cleanup: phone keyboard removed; test app force-stopped with 0 pending alarms; phone on its home screen; VM shut down from inside.
